raw:
You carry your mug into the kitchen and place it beside your plate. Your used napkin goes into the marked waste bin, and you return your chair to the table. You leave the remaining dishes and covered food to Jo and Owen.

A little after seven, Owen takes the rubbish out through the yard. Jo checks the refrigerator doors, switches off the kitchen lights and leaves with him. Nell remains at the table with the office diary open.

At twenty to eight, the auditorium doors swing outward. Rosa comes through with her camera case, followed by Bea and Martin. The six boards remain securely against the auditorium wall.

“All photographed,” Rosa tells Nell. “And I’ve got Martin’s account for each one. Two names still need checking.”

“One name,” Martin says.

“Two.”

Dev comes downstairs carrying the receiver case and his operating folder. “Before everyone goes, I need another test slot. Tomorrow evening would work if Hana’s available.”

Nell turns a page in the diary. “The auditorium is clear after half six.”

“Don’t give it away yet,” Martin says. “Rosa may need retakes.”

Rosa lowers the camera case to the floor. “I won’t know until I check the files.”

“Exactly.”

“And I’m not free tomorrow evening. I’m spending it with Beth.”

“The printer deadline is Wednesday.”

“I know when my deadline is.”

Martin looks towards the auditorium. “If one of those photographs has glare across the lettering, you’ll need the room.”

“Then I’ll speak to Nell when I know. Don’t reserve my time for me.”

The exchange has sharpened, but nobody looks to you for a ruling. You stay beside your cleared place and listen.

Martin starts to answer. Bea cuts in quietly. “She’s said she isn’t available.”

He presses his lips together, then nods. “All right.”

Nell sets her pen on the diary. “This is what I’m doing. Dev, I’ll hold tomorrow from seven until half seven provisionally. Confirm by noon once you’ve spoken to Hana. If she can’t come, the hold comes out. Rosa, if you need a retake, call me when you know and I’ll find an actual free time.”

“That works,” Dev says.

Rosa picks up her camera case. “Thank you.”

Nell writes the provisional hold in pencil, adding **CONFIRM BY 12.00** beneath Dev’s name. The room has been assigned without turning your presence into authority over it.
